record_title: Exact curvature and Euclidean area-growth laws for Lee--Wang Lagrangian shrinkers
limitations: The general (p,q) statements concern the parameterized Lee--Wang immersion with multiplicity, and the result does not establish nonlinear flow stability or occurrence as a compact-flow singularity. Euclidean centered area growth is distinct from Gaussian entropy. A forthcoming Braxton thesis on the same Möbius shrinker was not available for inspection, leaving residual originality risk.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Reproduces the unique Möbius area-ratio maximum and cone-density crossing constants from their scalar equations.
